answer.text:
For gaming and streaming under ₹2,000, the Maono AU-PM360TR is the top choice for PC and desk setups, while the Boya BY-M1 offers excellent versatility for starter setups across devices.
Recommended Microphones
1. Maono AU-PM360TR – Best for Gaming and Desktop Streaming
Type: Mini Condenser Microphone
Price: ₹1,700–₹2,000
Best For: Gaming, voice-over, podcasts, tutorial recordings, and livestreams
Compatibility: Windows PC, Mac, laptops, and recording software
Key Features: Captures rich and clear desktop audio; ideal for close-range recordings at your desk; plug-and-play for immediate use 1.
Pros: Excellent voice clarity, suitable for live streaming, reliable performance, smooth plug-and-play experience.
Cons: Not designed for mobile recording or on-the-go vlogging.
2. Boya BY-M1 – Most Versatile Wired Lavalier Mic
Type: Wired Clip-on Lavalier (TRRS)
Price: ₹900–₹1,200
Best For: Beginners, tutorials, gaming commentary, indoor recording, and flexible setups where mobility is needed
Compatibility: Android smartphones (adapter may be required for Type-C/Lightning), DSLR/mirrorless cameras, laptops, PCs, audio recorders 1.
Key Features: Long 6m cable, foam windscreen, and clean vocal capture; reduces room echo effectively.
Pros: Excellent value for money, multi-device compatibility, natural voice capture, widely trusted for beginner content creators.
Cons: Cable management can become cumbersome; requires proper battery/mode setup for mobile devices.
3. pTron KWM-1 – Wireless Type-C Option for Mobile Gaming and Streaming
Type: Wireless Lavalier Microphone (USB-C)
Price: ₹800–₹1,000
Best For: Mobile-first creators, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, on-the-go gaming content recording.
Key Features: Plug-and-play with USB-C compatibility, rechargeable, portable, freedom to move while recording 1.
Pros: Wireless convenience, ideal for walking vlogs or mobile setups.
Cons: Audio quality slightly behind condenser or wired mics; short-range limitations compared to premium wireless mics.
Selection Tips
For desktop streaming or PC gaming: Go with the Maono AU-PM360TR due to better audio fidelity and direct USB/PC compatibility.
For multi-device or beginner setups: The Boya BY-M1 provides versatility at an affordable price.
For mobile streaming or content creation on the go: Choose the pTron KWM-1 wireless microphone for freedom of movement.
Considerations
Budget microphones under ₹2,000 usually offer clean vocal quality but may not capture studio-grade audio. Focus on positioning the mic closer to your mouth, minimizing background noise, and using basic acoustic treatment in your room for the best results.
Confirm device compatibility (USB-C, Lightning, or TRRS) before purchasing to avoid connectivity issues.
